title: FIREの4%ルールとは？日本でそのまま使っていいのか経験者目線で考える
meta_description: FIREの4%ルールは、退職時の資産から毎年4%を使う考え方です。元の研究の前提、日本でそのまま使いにくい理由、暴落時の取り崩しを経験者目線で整理します。
lead: FIREの4%ルールは便利な目安ですが、数字を当てはめれば安心できる魔法ではありません。元の研究が何を検証したのか、日本の生活とどう違うのか、資産の上下を経験した僕が「使うならどこに注意するか」を整理します。
thumbnail_prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Asset type: 1:1 square Japanese website article thumbnail. Input image: the supplied local PNG is the exact character reference for 「まる」; preserve his recognizable dark spiky hair, black-rim glasses, facial identity, and white FIRE T-shirt, but freely change the pose and expression. Create a visually distinct high-impact design for an article about the FIRE 4% rule. Use a cinematic top-down view of a giant circular balance dial marked by a single bold 4% segment, with a narrow bridge crossing a stormy red market below and a calm landing area beyond. The character is crouched on the bridge near the center, gripping a safety rope and looking serious but alert; do not place him on the right edge. Make the typography part of the circular dial and bridge signage, using a strong diagonal composition with no bottom banner. Render only these exact Japanese words in large, mobile-legible display type: 「4%で足りる？」 and 「そのまま使える？」. No speech bubbles, no repeated left-text/right-character layout, no extra readable text, no personal name, age, address, phone, email, personal asset amount, watermark, browser frame, or gray panel.
